metadata.title: The Pressure-Supported Excess: What a Dark-Energy-Tied Galaxy Law Cannot Yet Explain, and Native-Input Shear Reruns on Both Footings (Working Note)
metadata.description:
Correction (v1.1, 2026-10-23): v1.0 presented the native shear result as a lead of the framework run over a 'matched control' NCS0. NCS0 is matched in initial conditions only: it is plain Poisson gravity and applies no gas expulsion, while the framework runs include the record's census gas expulsion M3, which re-places 3.2-3.7% of all mass. Following the repository lane CFG963 (commits d3b18181c, f2354ed22, 64718930a, e96c21a87; a diagnostic attribution, reported only), plain gravity plus the same M3 (a surrogate built from the 1024^3 pair T1x / T12) scores KiDS-1000 Delta chi^2 = -11.87 against NCS0, and the framework scores +1.78 (canonical) / +2.47 (alternative) against that feedback-matched control, within noise; the capped cold-sector rules alone score +2.66. The lead is M3-CARRIED on both footings and in all four M3 brackets. KiDS therefore cannot tell the framework's capped cold sector from plain gravity plus gas expulsion: the result shows that the capped cold sector does not overproduce structure (the uncapped settling engine was excluded at +68.7), not a preference for the law. The CONSISTENT class still holds against the fair control (|Delta chi^2| < 4); the stored Delta chi^2 values against NCS0 are unchanged as numbers; the amplitude, absolute-fit, CMB-lensing and engine-parent caveats stand, and per CFG963 the missing engine parent is not load-bearing for this result. The decisive 1024^3 control with gas expulsion is designed but not run.

Working note, version 1.1 (2026-10-23; v1.0 2026-10-21). AI-assisted research programme; not peer reviewed. kappa = 1/2 is fitted; the theory is not closed.

Two more days of pre-registered tests (criteria frozen before computing, mutation controls, post-hoc amendments disclosed, both a0 footings 9.36e-11 and 1.13e-10 m/s^2 reported and never pooled) of a gravity framework with galactic law g_N = g^2/(g + a0), a0 = (1/2) c sqrt(G rho_DE), whose extra gravitating mass is a collisionless 'cold energy' component, not a particle.

(1) Shear: rerun at 1024^3 from the framework's own early-universe inputs, the framework's particle-mesh structure is CONSISTENT with raw KiDS-1000 cosmic shear on both footings against the Poisson control NCS0, which is matched in initial conditions only (Delta chi^2 -10.08 canonical, -9.39 alternative); that lead is carried by the census gas expulsion, and against plain gravity with the same expulsion the framework scores +1.78 / +2.47, so KiDS cannot tell the capped cold sector from plain gravity plus gas expulsion (Correction v1.1). On the alternative footing DES Y3 is diagnostic and also CONSISTENT (-2.15); plain gravity with the expulsion gives -2.17 (Correction v1.1). Shear Delta chi^2 sizes are amplitude-driven (KiDS Delta chi^2 -3.11 to -15.80 canonical and -2.93 to -14.69 alternative over the projection Omega_m; about -2.9 / -2.8 with the framework's own covariance), no arm is a good absolute fit, and the engine that produces the pass has no established physical parent (companion note PAPER57), which per CFG963 is not load-bearing for this result (Correction v1.1). (2) CMB lensing: on raw Planck PR4 lensing (L 8-400) all four runs are indistinguishable from their controls, CONSISTENT only under a post-hoc amendment, with little power; a sealed Fisher forecast finds that S4-class lensing at L ~ 1000-2000 could separate them. (3) The pressure-supported excess: dwarfs, spheroidal lenses and cluster cores carry an excess over the law and rotating systems do not, but no single kinematic measure, local density or any of five candidate selectors sets the amounts, and the record's own cold-energy equations cannot select on kinematics. The cluster-core excess is not a baryon-census error and survives four small reframings. A stellar-IMF correction removes the red-lens excess if discs are not bottom-heavy; the dwarf excess survives every reframing tried; a fossil a0 helps only under the rival a0 proportional to H(z), which is reported as evidence about a0(z), not as a rescue.

Not derived: kappa = 1/2, the cold-to-baryon supply ratio, the retained fraction. A CONSISTENT class is not a preference. Companion notes: PAPER55 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23482936) and PAPER57. AI assistance: Anthropic's Claude (analysis lanes, review, drafting).
